ops.title: Hermes swapfile creation must order after systemd-growfs-root
ops.body: The 8 GiB mkswap-var-swapfile dd races the stage-2 disk growth (boot.growPartition = growpart.service -> systemd-growfs-root.service at the 25.05 pin) and ENOSPCs on the minimized repart image's first boot (~2 GiB free pre-grow). hermes.nix pins systemd.services.mkswap-var-swapfile after/wants systemd-growfs-root.service — do not remove that ordering. Scratch-VM validated: journal shows mkswap strictly after growfs; 8 GiB swap active on first boot. See memory:repart-image-migration-facts.
